comparison.objective: Produce a sound TIG bead with torch and filler rod; the candidate sets and verifies a mechanical opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous bimanual heat-path and filler control versus discrete screw adjustment, jam-nut countertorque, and tool withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: All seam segments are sound without contamination or burn-through and tools are returned; candidate requires angle accuracy and cycle retention.
comparison.reason: Weld-process control and bead quality do not test preservation of an adjustable stop under locking torque.
